ctx.x: These were all good piano players. Yeah, yeah. Good. Did you listen to anybody on drums much when you got started to learn from them?

Well they had some real good drummers. Roy was really terrific. Alfred, he's great. Who? Alfred Williams. I used to hear Black Benny, Ray Happy, was that the lyrics? Uh-huh. Oh, a good many of them. They was good drummers.
What about saxophone players in those days? When did that come in?
